text:
Predicates:
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromCSDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakesDatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedBy(x, y) ::: x is instructed by y.
WorksInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
Question:
James is a student working in the lab. Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Premises:
¬∃x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x) ∧ HasPartTimeJob(x)) ::: No students who work in the library have a part-time job offered by the university.
∀x (HasPartTimeJob(x) → WorksInLibrary(x)) ::: All students with part-time jobs are students who work in the library.
∀x (TakesDatabaseCourse(x) → FromCSDept(x)) ::: All students taking the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (InstructedBy(x, professorDavid) → TakesDatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (WorksInLab(x) → InstructedBy(x, professorDavid)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
Student(james) ∧ WorksInLab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬(HasPartTimeJob(jack) ∨ WorksInLab(jack)) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Question:
TakesDatabaseCourse(james) ∨ HasPartTimeJob(james)
